scope: Freshness and route-specific cross-check of peer failure reports against existing local owners; no code, build, test, fixture, dependency, or external execution.

local_crosswalk.peer_mechanism: Per-APPID EED byte length narrowed to signed 16-bit short; reported 32768-byte input wraps and loses the entity on peer readback.
local_crosswalk.local_evidence_already_present: Unsigned 16-bit chunk boundaries at 32767, 32768, 65535, and 65536 encoded bytes; split at item boundaries; following-field sentinel; atomic refusal/retry for an indivisible oversized item.
local_crosswalk.disposition: No local finding; do not copy peer threshold as a format cap.

local_crosswalk.peer_mechanism: Current-culture lowercasing can corrupt ANSI_1254 lookup under Turkish/Azeri locales.
local_crosswalk.disposition: Existing ASCII-invariant resolution and locale control cover the mechanism; no new test.

local_crosswalk.peer_mechanism: Recursive advancement for comments, repeated XDATA APPID groups, and repeated IMAGE/WIPEOUT clip groups.
local_crosswalk.local_owner: Existing iterative DXF parser and hardening selector testRepeatedDxfRecordRobustness
local_crosswalk.disposition: Existing 20000-record generated controls; no repeated stress run.

local_crosswalk.disposition: Existing targeted recovery controls; do not generalize to mesh/polyface child roles.
